title: Fabled
description: A land Fabled to be extraordinary!
body:
Fabled
Forge 1.20.1 | Adventure Awaits

Step into a world where myths come alive and every horizon hides a new adventure. Fabled is a survival-focused, exploration-driven modpack that brings the thrill of discovery to the forefront — whether you’re braving the unknown alone or journeying with friends.

Venture through breathtaking new dimensions like The **Twilight Forest** and **The Aether Redux**, uncover ancient ruins, battle mythical beasts from **Mowzie’s Mobs**, and unearth secrets in beautifully generated worlds filled with custom structures and biomes.

Whether you’re building a base nestled in enchanted woods or leading expeditions into forgotten realms, Fabled offers an experience full of wonder, danger, and storybook magic.

🔹 Key Features:

- New dimensions to explore and conquer
  
- Powerful and cinematic boss battles
  
- Custom worldgen with mysterious structures
  
- Tailored for both single-player and multiplayer adventures
  
- Balanced for survival gameplay with a focus on exploration

Below is one of the dimension mods that is **not** included already in the pack, please download the correct version and place it into the mod files:

[Twilight Forest](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-twilight-forest/files/5468648)
